$ commit-hub-files.sh only-message
[exit 1]
--- stdout
--- stderr
usage: commit-hub-files.sh "<message>" <path>...

$ commit-hub-files.sh m hub.json todo.md
[exit 0]
--- stdout
commit-hub-files: todo.md is not config (data does not go into git), skipped
commit-hub-files: <TMP>/config is not a git repo, nothing committed
--- stderr

$ commit-hub-files.sh m hub.json todo.md
[exit 0]
--- stdout
commit-hub-files: todo.md is not config (data does not go into git), skipped
commit-hub-files: committed and pushed: hub.json
--- stderr

$ commit-hub-files.sh m hub.json
[exit 0]
--- stdout
commit-hub-files: hub.json unchanged, nothing committed
--- stderr

$ commit-hub-files.sh m nope.txt nope2.txt
[exit 0]
--- stdout
commit-hub-files: none of nope.txt nope2.txt exists, nothing committed
--- stderr
